items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: you ever hear of “One Night Jacks” by Hugo Friedhofer, that’s a Marlon Brando picture?

ctx.x: Do you have any recollections of days in the studio when you really were hurting for one reason or another? You really didn’t have it, and it was a struggle for you to get through a cue or something?

I don’t know. I really don’t know, because it’s a habit. You see when you’re considered a top studio player, your facilities, whatever it is, legitimately — you ever hear of “One Night Jacks” by Hugo Friedhofer, that’s a Marlon Brando picture?
